name: workflow-tools
description: Codex planning, independent counsel, explanations, sidebar recovery, toolbox synchronization, and explicit shipping skills.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, explain, recover sidebars, sync, and ship.
interface.longDescription: Workflow Tools packages ChatGPT Planner for GPT-6 Pro consultation in Codex Plan Mode, Claude Counselor for bounded independent planning and code review, Explain Clearly for concise explanations, Deep Planning for adversarial critique, Recover Codex Sidebar for on-request macOS project mapping recovery after account switches, Sync Toolbox for applying the published toolbox to this machine, and Ship Toolbox for explicit validation, commit, push, CI, and local marketplace refresh workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use $recover-codex-sidebar to restore missing sidebar projects after switching Codex accounts on macOS.
Use $chatgpt-planner to consult the connected GPT-6 Pro conversation for this Plan-mode objective.
Use $explain-clearly to answer directly, adapt the depth to my question, and add examples or visuals only when they help.
Use $deep-planning to critique this plan before implementation.
Use $claude-counselor for bounded independent planning and final code review on major work.
Use $ship-toolbox to validate, commit, push, refresh, and verify the current toolbox changes.
Use $sync-toolbox to update this machine from published main and verify the full managed setup.
Review this Plan Mode request for assumptions, risks, and routing.
